name: Paiute
description: Paiute is a Hawaiian draw-and-discard game similar to Knock Poker. Players draw and discard to form five- or six-card poker combinations. A turn-up card sets the wild rank. Unique: a player can call with a six-card hand (Three Pairs, called Paiute) on their first draw only.

content.text: Paiute is a Hawaiian draw-and-discard game similar to Knock Poker. Players draw and discard to form five- or six-card poker combinations. A turn-up card sets the wild rank. Unique: a player can call with a six-card hand (Three Pairs, called Paiute) on their first draw only.
Hawaiian game; documented from contributions by Derek Bal, Malia Pugh, and Pomai T.
Two to five players use a standard international 52-card pack; ace ranks high. Five cards are dealt to each player; the next card is turned face up to set the wild rank for that deal.
Standard deck, chips or money for stakes.
